g.title: cluster_legend_state
g.text: a state: what it runs, top to bottom

g.title: f0__adjudicate__0
g.text: The blocked rows still waiting for a side — a row already adjudicated keeps its

g.title: f0__adjudicate__1
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__adjudicate__2
g.text: Read the other side: the story the node's code was last written to, and its text.

g.title: f0__adjudicate__3
g.text: adjudicate one blocked finding: which side is wrong?

g.title: f0__adjudicate__4
g.text: Route one verdict. Every branch writes the verdict and the chain on the row.

g.title: f0__checkpoint__0
g.text: Canonicalize the book, then read doctor, then queue the repairs it names.

g.title: f0__retry_blocked__0
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__adjudicate__4->f0__retry_blocked__0
g.text: rows still blocked after verdicts: operator gate

g.title: f0__select__0
g.text: Pop the next pending item and mark it active.

g.title: f0__checkpoint__1
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__checkpoint__1->f0__adjudicate__0
g.text: blocked rows and nothing pending: read the other side

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__0
g.text: Materialize a deterministic multi-language source inventory for OKF coverage.

g.title: f0__checkpoint__1->f0__rescan_coverage__0
g.text: re-scan cap hit, inventory still short: operator gate

g.title: f0__checkpoint__1->f0__retry_blocked__0
g.text: findings unchanged for the stall cap: operator gate

g.title: f0__seed_surfaces__0
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__record_item__0
g.text: Retire one regrounding row by re-reading the file the turn just documented against.

g.title: f0__investigate->f0__record_item__0
g.text: turn finished: record what it wrote

g.title: f0__seed_recheck__0
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__record_item__1
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__1
g.text: Compute the book's coverage — the verdict the agent used to emit.

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__2
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__2->f0__recheck__0
g.text: uncovered units: ask whether they are units

g.title: f0__rescan_coverage__2->f0__select__0
g.text: cited source moved: re-ground those nodes

g.title: f0__select__1
g.text: Canonicalize the book, then read doctor, then queue the repairs it names.

g.title: f0__select__1->f0__checkpoint__0
g.text: the drain is dry: run doctor

g.title: f0__select__1->f0__refuel
g.text: item ceiling hit with work pending: ask for more

g.title: f0__start->f0__checkpoint__0
g.text: the book exists: reconcile it to HEAD

g.title: f0__start->f0__enumerate_surfaces__0
g.text: no book yet: fill it from the entry surfaces

g.title: f0__walkthrough__0->f0____end
g.text: book complete: walked when there is an app

g.title: f1__start__0
g.text: Start the app under walk and wait for it to answer its health path.

g.title: f1__checkpoint__0
g.text: Canonicalize the book, then read doctor, then queue the repairs it names.

g.title: f1__checkpoint__1
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f1__checkpoint__2
g.text: Reap the app this run started (or run its documented `stop:` recipe).

g.title: f1__checkpoint__3
g.text: Reap the shared browser, if this run is the one that started it.

g.title: f1__pick__0
g.text: Pop the next pending item and mark it active.

g.title: f1__mark__0
g.text: Mark the current item done, merge newly-discovered items, and count the re-tries.

g.title: f1__pick__1
g.text: Reap the app this run started (or run its documented `stop:` recipe).

g.title: f1__pick__2
g.text: Reap the shared browser, if this run is the one that started it.

g.title: f1__walk__0
g.text: walk one WEB journey against the LIVE app

g.title: f1__start__1
g.text: Own the shared CDP browser's lifecycle.

g.title: f1__start__2
g.text: Seed the walk worklist with the *unconfirmed* delta.

g.title: f1__start__3
g.text: Reap the app this run started (or run its documented `stop:` recipe).

g.title: f1__start__4
g.text: Reap the shared browser, if this run is the one that started it.

g.title: f1__start__4->f1__pick__0
g.text: app and browser up: walk seeded

g.title: f1__start__4->f1____end
g.text: no screen surfaces: nothing to walk

g.title: f1__start__4->f1____end
g.text: the app would not come up

g.title: legend_c->legend_d
g.text: await: parked on an operator gate

g.title: legend_handoff
g.text: run to its END, then back here
